verses.text: For the music director, to the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A psalm by Asaph. A song. Thank you, God! We thank you because your name is near. People tell stories of the wonders you’ve done.
“When I decide the time has come, I’ll judge fairly.
The earth shakes, and everyone on it trembles. I’m the one who holds its pillars steady.” Selah.
I told the arrogant, “Quit bragging!” I told the wicked, “Keep your horns down.
Don’t raise your horns high or talk with your necks stiff and proud.”
Being lifted up doesn’t come from the east, the west, or the south.
God is the judge. He brings one person down and lifts another up.
The LORD holds a cup of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out, and the wicked of the earth drink it down to the last drop.
As for me, I’ll keep telling this forever. I’ll sing praise to the God of Jacob.
“I’ll cut off every horn of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous will be raised high.”
